title: Retain a one-condition exponentially rare full-fiber rejection example
statement: For binary X of shape p by2,Y of shape2 by2 and XY=0, full population is 2^(2p)+9*2^p+6. The rank-two character condition traceY=1 has population6*2^p+2, so full-fiber rejection succeeds asymptotically6*2^-p although c=1.

requires: Literal binary factor-pair problem with traceY=1
provides: Exact failure of full-fiber rejection and of old rank-one admission on this condition
assumptions: Not the separate Y11=1 example with population4*2^p+4
Not hardness for every sampler; literal p=64 control is not raw native acquisition
costs: New generic sampler uses two original characters plus polynomial work
contract.units: Binary independent-input bits and binary affine codimension; q=2^a; natural module dimensions are divided by a*p. Bit operations and exact integer probabilities. Source timings are seconds on the recorded environment.
contract.obstruction: Small codimension does not bound the acceptance of full-fiber rejection.
